snippet.title: Bloom & Dine — Official Trailer | Cozy cats, busy shifts | Match-3 Cooking Game
snippet.description:
Bloom & Dine mixes time management, match-3 and cooking: match on the board to fire up the stoves, fit each dish in before your guests run out of patience, and keep a few kitchens running through 99 in-game days.

Demo out now, full game coming to Steam in December.
Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5356890/Bloom__Dine/

Made by Grey Cold Production — a tiny indie studio (just me and my cat, Mouse).
